findings.summary: The trace graph sample incorrectly maps Requirements R1, R2, and R3 to Milestone M2. In the plan, M2 ('Phase B') is scoped strictly to Backlinks and Forward Links (verifying AT8 and AT9), while R1, R2, and R3 are delivered and verified in Milestone M1 ('Phase A') and regression-tested in M5 ('Phase C').

evidence.note: Milestone M1 explicitly includes exit criteria for AT1 (R1), AT2 (R2), and AT3 (R3), confirming primary verification occurs here.
evidence.quote: AT1 passes... AT2 passes... AT3 passes...

evidence.note: Milestone M2 exit criteria are limited to AT8, AT9, and K10; they do not encompass R1, R2, or R3.
evidence.quote: AT8 passes... AT9 passes... K10 mitigation verified...

evidence.note: Milestone M2 deliverables are specific to the Backlink Resolver and Backlink rendering, not core file discovery or basic page rendering.
evidence.quote: Backlink Resolver Plugin (C11)... Backlink section rendered...
